homepageAuditRow.next_step: Manually review density/repetition before adding more CTAs or public managed-service copy.

rows.evidence: Homepage audit status: REVIEW; primary CTAs: 10; unique CTA texts: 5; repeated text groups: שליחת פנייה (6).
rows.recommendation: Treat this as a visual/content decision before adding more homepage CTAs or managed-service copy.
rows.owner_decision_needed: Confirm whether repeated lawyer-card action labels are acceptable, should be quieter, or should become contextual.
rows.blocker: No homepage CTA label, link, section or CMS change is approved by this packet.

rows.item: Option A - keep repeated labels for now
rows.evidence: The repeated buttons point to different lawyer contact URLs and no repeated href group was found in the audit.
rows.recommendation: Keep current live homepage unchanged until a broader homepage design pass is approved.
rows.owner_decision_needed: Approve leaving the current repeated visible label as-is for now.
rows.blocker: Still block adding new homepage CTA blocks until density is reviewed again.

rows.item: Option B - make repeated lawyer-card actions visually quieter
rows.evidence: The repeated text appears inside a card/list pattern, where each card can keep a local action without competing with main page CTAs.
rows.recommendation: Consider a subtler secondary-action style or compact icon/text treatment for lawyer cards while keeping main legal-help CTAs clearer.
rows.owner_decision_needed: Approve a design treatment after mobile and desktop screenshot review.
rows.blocker: Needs local theme diff, mobile screenshot, desktop screenshot and CTA density rerun before publication.

rows.item: Option C - vary lawyer-card labels by user intent
rows.evidence: The live homepage currently repeats one visible action label across several lawyer cards.
rows.recommendation: Test contextual labels such as "פרטי עורך הדין" or "בדיקת התאמה" only if the actual target and user expectation match.
rows.owner_decision_needed: Approve exact Hebrew labels and decide whether card clicks go to contact or profile.
rows.blocker: Do not create misleading labels; copy needs user-intent review and link-destination review.

rows.item: Option D - reduce lawyer-card CTA exposure
rows.evidence: Homepage has 10 primary CTAs in the current audit, with lawyer-card actions making up most of the repeated visible label.
rows.recommendation: Consider showing fewer cards or one section-level CTA if mobile feels too sales-heavy.
rows.owner_decision_needed: Approve a larger homepage layout decision before implementation.
rows.blocker: Higher public UX impact; requires competitor-inspired design review and stronger visual QA.

rows.item: Keep public site as legal help first
rows.evidence: Owner explicitly objected to public copy that exposes revenue logic or business-plan language.
rows.recommendation: Any public homepage copy must stay reader-facing: legal problem, lawyer fit, guidance and trust.
rows.owner_decision_needed: None until a concrete homepage change is proposed.
rows.blocker: No business-plan, revenue, package-economics, supplier marketplace or internal routing language on the public homepage.

rows.item: Associated pages and surfaces to inspect
rows.recommendation: If homepage card actions change, inspect these pages for internal-link flow, repeated CTA language and cannibalization context.
rows.owner_decision_needed: Choose whether homepage lawyer-card traffic should primarily feed lawyer profiles, contact forms or practice pages.
rows.blocker: No internal link or public route decision from this packet alone.

rows.item: Required QA before any homepage CTA change goes live
rows.evidence: The current audit is read-only and does not include screenshots.
rows.recommendation: Before publishing: mobile screenshot, desktop screenshot, live/public business-language audit, CTA density rerun, private artifact boundary guard and Hebrew owner email with associated-page notes.
rows.blocker: No uPress pull or owner email until a real public change is implemented and live-verified.
